body:
## Summary

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#129.

This PR preserves the selected MP4 output format across every file in a batch render and documents the issue analysis requested in the issue.

## Changes

- Captures the selected output format once before the batch conversion loop and passes that same requested format into every conversion.
- Names rendered recordings from the actual video blob MIME type, so MP4 outputs are shown and downloaded as .mp4 even when fallback metadata differs.
- Adds focused Cypress regression coverage for batch MP4 naming and batch format consistency.
- Adds issue artifacts and case-study analysis under docs/case-studies/issue-129/.

## Reproduction

Before the fix, selecting multiple audio files and choosing MP4 could render the first file as .mp4 while subsequent files rendered or appeared as .webm.

## Verification

- npm test -- --runInBand
- npm run typecheck
- npm run build

Targeted Cypress command attempted:

- npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/batch-visualization.cy.js

In this workspace, Cypress could not be completed because local static server processes exited immediately without binding http://localhost:8080. The failure log is environment setup related: Cypress could not verify that the configured baseUrl server was running.
